decisions.reason: Certified HVAC gasketed plate heat exchangers are close to the core offer and serve steady demand, so withdrawing them makes little sense even without recent website evidence.
The marine box cooler line holds a major market share in water cooling systems and remains a strong revenue contributor.
Compact oil coolers build on established competence and serve recurring industrial and transportation demand with low ongoing cost.
Finned tubes are a core component that supports the firm's own air cooler production as well as external sales.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes reflect the firm's R&D strength and support its efficiency and sustainability promise.
